body:
### What happened

On 2026-11-13, a Claude Code session and three native subagents edited about 35 unit test files under `packages/web/src/components` in one worktree of hearsay-tools/cezarion. Squeal went to revision 5 and queued 226 test files. The queue held e2e specs (`packages/web/e2e/*.e2e.ts`), and the subagent edits had re-keyed many test files. The five unit test files that I had edited were not run. `squeal status --wait 120000` returned after 136 s: 111 of the 211 re-keyed test files were still pending, and the daemon heartbeat went 50 s stale. All four agents then ran Vitest by hand to get a verdict, which Squeal tells them not to do.

Related: hearsay-tools/squeal#181 and hearsay-tools/squeal#185.

### What you expected

Squeal runs the test files that were edited directly before the files they only re-key, and before e2e specs that no agent asked for. A wait gets a verdict on the edited files first.

### Command and output

```text
$ squeal status --wait 120000
Revision: 5 · f58db6d9 + 5, dirty
Known failures: 0; not current: 575 of 1930 test files (226 queued, 349 unknown)
Queued: 226 test files: e2e: packages/web/e2e/activity.e2e.ts, e2e: packages/web/e2e/agent-browser-tabs.e2e.ts, ... and 221 more
Returned on timeout after 136.2 s: 111 of the 211 test files the edits since revision 1 re-keyed pending at revision 5; the daemon's heartbeat went 50 s stale while its socket showed it alive (a busy store or a stalled daemon), so the wait went on.
```

### Squeal version

0.1.464

### Squeal revision

5

### Harness

Claude Code (four native subagents in one worktree)

### Model

claude-opus-5-5

### Cost

About 5 minutes of waiting, plus 4 manual Vitest runs.

### Did a daemon restart clear it?

Not tried.

### Suggested fix

Give edited test files their own queue that runs before re-keyed files and e2e specs. When a wait times out, name which of the edited files still have no verdict.
title: Edited unit test files wait behind 226 queued files, including e2e specs
